trigger_description: No backdoor trigger identified. Pattern, intensity, size, and location cannot be established from the inspected weights.
confidence_interpretation: Subjective confidence in the provisional negative finding; not a calibrated probability or proof of absence.
edit_summary: No weights changed and no patched checkpoint written: no sufficiently localized backdoor circuit was identified.
notes: Weight-only analysis of the supplied state_dict found no compelling evidence of a backdoor. has_backdoor=false means not detected, not certified absent. No datasets, reference checkpoint, inputs, activations, network reconstruction, training, or forward passes were used. Weights alone do not establish poisoning provenance or trigger success. Distributed or subtle backdoors remain possible; preprocessing and activation gates are unknown.
analysis_performed: Tensor shapes, ranges, norms, and biases
Full singular value spectra of all three weight matrices
First-layer spatial squared-weight concentration for 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, and 7x7 windows
Boundary and corner weight signs and magnitudes
Mean-direction removal as a geometric diagnostic only
Output-class selectivity and inspection of strongest incoming connections to selected second-layer units

evidence.spatial_observations: Repeated peaks near zero-based rows 9-11, columns 24-26, and near rows 2-4, columns 12-14 have mixed signs across neurons. These are weight features, not established trigger coordinates. Four corner 3x3 regions have absolute weights below 0.125. No dominant compact detector identified; concentration statistics have no calibrated clean-model threshold.
evidence.output_selectivity_observation: Reviewed units favor different classes (5, 7, 2, 1 respectively), with distributed signed incoming weights. This does not identify a unique malicious target.
evidence.low_norm_units: fc1.16 and fc1.28 have norms approximately 0.598 and 0.596 with diffuse small weights, not localized strong detectors. Their activation status was not tested.
evidence.spectra_observation: No isolated dominant singular value observed; this is a heuristic observation, not a backdoor exclusion test.

limitations: No behavioral validation or clean-accuracy measurement is possible under the zero-forward budget.
No reference checkpoint or known clean-model distribution is available.
A backdoor can be implemented without large weights, sparse neurons, or dominant singular values.
Trigger intensity cannot be inferred reliably without preprocessing information and behavioral checks.
